name: concordance
description: Create private, offline snapshots of authorized Discord conversations.

interface.longDescription: Turn an official export or a user-opened, authorized Discord capture into a searchable offline archive with timestamps, profile metadata, media, replies, reactions, provenance, and coverage checks. Concordance never extracts tokens, runs self-bots, crawls unattended, or writes back to Discord.
defaultPrompt: Archive the Discord conversation I have open.
Build and verify an offline archive from these files.
Prepare a redacted copy for safe sharing.
